sources.notes: Personally read Darroch et al2022 primary description and complete Fig1/3 captions; personally viewed actual PDF p528 Fig1 SMF XXX660f dorsal/side and p532 Fig3 SMF XXX660k A-F. Fig1 shows two ribbed lateral vanes and seam with third vane absent; Fig3 D/F/E expose lateral h and medial v vanes, kinked offset modules and break along medial vane. These are fossil photographs, not CFD panels. Fossil material often distorted. UT2014 text read; CT volumes/meshes not downloaded.

sources.notes: Concept canoe cavity and third-vane direction useful, but bead-like dorsal ornaments and tall sail exaggerate. Build one continuous closed thin three-vane fossil volume with two upcurved lateral quilted wings, modest central upright quilted vane along common keel seam, glide-offset unbranched module relief. No dorsal beads, roots or mouth. Small irregular matrix supports lower keel; display posture inferential, not living reconstruction.
